ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Bandhan Bank Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Vinay Jain as Interim Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), effective September 26, 2026, until March 31, 2027. While this ensures continuity in a critical financial leadership role, the interim nature of the appointment for an extended period (over six months) suggests potential ongoing transitions or challenges in securing a permanent CFO, which could warrant further scrutiny by investors. The disclosure also updates the bank's authorized KMP list for regulatory reporting purposes.
